topic: Handling leak detection calls during a busy route
hook_options: You are in a crawlspace. The phone rings. You let it go.
The plumber who picks up gets the leak repair. Not the best one.
We hear the same thing from plumbers all the time: I miss too many leak calls while working.
How many leak detection calls went to voicemail while you were under a house today?
Three leak calls you missed today went to the next guy on Google.
tweets: You are in a crawlspace. The phone rings. You let it go.
It is a homeowner with a leak panic. They hang up on the beep and dial the next number on the list.
That is a service call walking straight to someone else because your hands were full.
Pipeline Reception catches those calls. It answers when your team cannot, takes the details, and books the job right into your schedule. We can set you up in a day.
caption:
Ever lose a good leak job because you were elbow-deep in a repair?

Missing calls on the route costs real money every week.

How do you handle the phone when you are solo in the field?
